description: This PHP class file defines the LeavePluginConfiguration class which implements PluginConfigurationInterface. It initializes various leave-related services by registering them with a dependency injection container and adds an event subscriber related to leave events, configuring the leave plugin for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LeavePluginConfiguration
classes.description: Implements plugin setup for leave management by registering services and event subscribers within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the leave plugin by registering relevant services and adding the leave event subscriber to the dispatcher.
